title: SignalSynth: Sales-facing Model Availability & Competitive Alert Feed (APAC+EU pilot)
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Goal: build a concise, operational feed (SignalSynth) that synthesizes model availability, latency/economics shifts, and competitive product changes into sales- and procurement-facing alerts. This is a pilot scoped to APAC and EU regions to validate signal fidelity and downstream actionability.

Why: Sales and Customer Success report long lead times to diagnose ‘model regressions’ (errors, latency spikes, availability drops) and to quantify vendor substitution risk during procurement conversations. Ops teams have raw telemetry but no curated decision support for pre-sales or renewal conversations.

Deliverables: 
- Signal aggregation pipeline design doc (Confluence) outlining inputs, scoring heuristics and thresholds.
- Prototype feed UI widget in Sales Portal + exportable CSV/Slack digest.
- 2 automated alert classes: Availability (outage/degraded), Cost Shock (token-rate/latency > baseline), and Capability Drift (model quality signal via eval sample failures).
- Runbook for SDR/AE playbook triggers and procurement handoff.

Data sources: Redwood console latency/cost dashboards, model catalog change log, external model-provenance trackers, public model supply signals, and Region-specific cloud capacity alerts.

Success metrics (pilot): 
- Median time-to-first-action by AE after alert <= 24h for high-severity alerts.
- False positive rate <= 12% on availability alerts (measured by 2-week manual audit).
- Pilot AEs report feed is ‘useful’ or ‘very useful’ in 75% of check-ins.

Risks & trade-offs: 
- Signal noise if thresholds are too sensitive -> increased AE churn. Mitigation: conservative thresholds + human-in-the-loop tuning in first 4 weeks.
- Data latency for upstream telemetry (5–30s) may affect real-time needs; prioritize visibility, not necessarily instantaneous action.
- Ownership blur between Product, Observability and Sales Ops. Establish RACI up front.

Acceptance criteria: see acceptance_criteria field.

Stakeholders: 
- PM: Anika Rao (owner)
- Eng: Luca Fernandez (owner), Priya Mehta (backend), Jamal Ortiz (frontend)
- Sales Ops: Kira Patel
- Observability: Mateo Li

Next steps: 
1) Kickoff workshop with Sales Ops and Observability (scheduled 2026-02-18). 
2) Draft scoring heuristics and Confluence doc (owner: Anika) by 2026-02-22.
3) Prototype API + minimal UI slice for AE test by 2026-03-18.

Notes: This ticket focuses on signal definitions and the AE-facing productization layer. Full platform integration (automated remediation, auto-fallback) will be a later phase (see dependencies).
